response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced polyglot engineer with strong systems and web development background, but their career centers on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang rather than C++. C++ experience is limited to a brief 6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a bachelor thesis project, and there is no evidence of industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443), SDL practices, MQTT/IoT protocols, or industrial automation domain experience — all core to this role.
strengths: Extensive experience with high-performance, low-latency, event-driven systems (async I/O, fibers, micro-services handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
Broad full-stack and cloud/infrastructure exposure (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, message-driven architectures)
concerns: Minimal and dated professional C++ experience (~6 months in 2014–2015); primary languages are TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
No demonstrated industrial cybersecurity, SDL, or IEC 62443 experience
No exposure to industrial automation domain or protocols (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, DNP 3.0)

key_factors.factor: Strong distributed-systems and performance engineering skills
